map.广告 ROI 模拟：CPC 模式 点击数=预算÷CPC、展示=点击÷CTR；CP: Ad ROI simulation: in CPC mode clicks = budget / CPC and impressions = clicks / CTR; in CPM mode impressions = budget / CPM × 1000 and clicks = impressions × CTR. Revenue = clicks × CVR × average order value, gross profit = revenue × (1 − cost rate) − fixed costs, ROI = gross profit / budget. Adjust bid, CTR or CVR to compare profit and loss across delivery plans.

map.预算 10000 元、CPC 2 元、CTR 2% → 点击 5000、展示 2: Budget 10000 CNY, CPC 2 CNY, CTR 2% gives 5000 clicks and 250000 impressions; 100 orders at an average order value of 300 CNY gives revenue 30000 CNY; with a 40% gross margin the goods cost is 12000 CNY, total cost 22000 CNY and profit 8000 CNY.
=8000/22000≈36.4%; break-even ROAS = 1/(1−0.4) = 1.67, so it is already profitable.
map.若利润为负，公式给出：转化率需提升到 预算/(客单价×点击量)，或客单价提升到: If profit is negative, the formula gives: conversion rate must rise to budget / (average order value × clicks), or average order value must rise to budget / (clicks × conversion rate). For example with 5000 clicks, an average order value of 300 and a budget of 10000, the conversion rate must reach 10000/(300×5000) = 0.67% to break even.
map.ROAS 和 ROI 有什么区别？: What is the difference between ROAS and ROI?
map.ROAS=广告收入/广告花费，只看广告杠杆；ROI=(收入−总成本)/总成本，扣: ROAS = ad revenue / ad spend and only looks at advertising leverage; ROI = (revenue − total cost) / total cost, which deducts goods cost and fixed costs and reflects true profit or loss.
map.盈亏平衡 ROAS = 1 ÷ 毛利率。毛利率 40% 时只要 ROAS≥1.6: Break-even ROAS = 1 / gross margin. With a 40% gross margin, ROAS ≥ 1.67 means no loss; below that a loss is certain.
